Name: Krobus Sells Vinegar
Author: CopperSun
Description:
Now you can boycott Pierre while enjoying a delicious homemade salad! Krobus sells discounted vinegar on Sundays and Wednesdays. Joja will also sell vinegar if you have a membership.

This is a VERY simple mod using Shop Tile Framework. If you are interested in creating your own mod involving a new shop or edits to existing shops, you're invited to look at the code and see how easy it is or read this [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki/wiki/Tutorial:_Adding_Items_to_a_Shop]detailed tutorial designed for absolute beginners[/url]. One word of warning, however: the conditions used for "when" in STF are a little different from Content Patcher, so make sure you test your mod prior to release!

[u]Compatibility[/u]
There is no reason for this mod to be incompatible with any other mod unless you have a mod that removes Krobus' shop from the game.
